name: Rokku
origin: Online (Gyaru magazines, Shibuya 109, Laforet Harajuku, Ameba and CROOZ blogs)
summary: Rokku (ロック; Rock) is a sub-style of Gyaru that incorporates elements of goth , punk , and visual kei .
description: Rokku (ロック; Rock) is a sub-style of Gyaru that incorporates elements of goth , punk , and visual kei . It is darker in fashion than other gyaru styles, with a heavy emphasis on black clothing, intense eye makeup, and Gothic imagery like skulls and crosses. Unlike many substyles, Rokku does not require a tan, and instead places focus on personal creativity through makeup, hair and accessorizing.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Rebellion, creativity, counterculture, bold self-expression, individuality
